title: Asynchronous, Generation-Free ABC: Streaming AMIS Reweighting for Heterogeneous Simulator Workloads on HPC
abstract: arXiv:2610.29506v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Approximate Bayesian computation (ABC) enables Bayesian inference for models with intractable likelihoods by estimating parameter posterior distributions from simulated data. Sequential ABC methods improve sampling efficiency by iteratively adapting the proposal distribution toward regions of high posterior probability. However, these methods typically operate in generations, where each generation must wait for its slowest simulation before the next can begin. On a parallel machine, this synchronization barrier leaves workers idle and reduces throughput, particularly when simulation runtimes vary substantially. We introduce a generation-free ABC sampler that updates its proposal when simulation results arrive and sends a new candidate to each available worker. The proposal is based on the best particles evaluated so far. To estimate the posterior, we reuse the full history and reweight particles against a reconstructed mixture of sampl

translated_title: 异步、无代际的ABC：面向HPC上异构模拟器工作负载的流式AMIS重加权方法
translated_abstract: 近似贝叶斯计算（ABC）通过对模拟数据进行参数后验分布估计，使具有难以处理的似然函数的模型也能进行贝叶斯推断。序贯ABC方法通过迭代地将提议分布向高后验概率区域调整来提高采样效率。然而，这些方法通常以“代”为单位运行，每一代必须等待其最慢的模拟完成后才能开始下一代。在并行机器上，这种同步屏障会导致工作节点闲置并降低吞吐量，尤其是当模拟运行时间差异很大时。我们提出了一种无代际的ABC采样器，它在模拟结果到达时即更新提议分布，并向每个可用的工作节点发送新的候选样本。该提议分布基于迄今为止评估出的最佳粒子。为了估计后验分布，我们复用完整的历史记录，并基于重构的采样混合分布对粒子进行流式重加权。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无代际的异步ABC采样器，通过在模拟结果到达时即时更新提议分布，并利用流式AMIS重加权复用全部历史粒子，消除了并行计算中的同步屏障，显著提升了异构模拟器工作负载在高性能计算环境下的吞吐量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a generation-free asynchronous ABC sampler that updates its proposal distribution as simulation results arrive and reuses the full particle history via streaming AMIS reweighting, eliminating synchronization barriers and substantially improving throughput for heterogeneous simulator workloads on HPC systems.
